source_references.description: Lexical/reporting heuristics only: references are strings compared with known corpus URIs. No setting opens files, fetches URLs or changes source provenance. Alphanumeric byte classification and extension-suffix extraction remain universal scanner operations. Empty forbidden lists disable those exclusions; empty lexical/trim/boundary character sets match no characters. require_path_marker=false disables marker eligibility; true with an empty marker list selects no references.
